title: It's A Wonderful Life 2026
seo_title: It's A Wonderful Life 2026 at Gillioz Theatre, Springfield
description: This is a free showing of the film It's A Wonderful Life, with free hot chocolate while supplies last and free photo ops with Mr. & Mrs. Claus. It is a family-friendly film event, and tickets must be reserved by phone at 417-863-9491 or at the Gillioz Box Office starting November 9 at 10 am, with a 4 ticket limit per order and general admission seating. It takes place Sunday, December 13, 2026 at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central E., Springfield, MO, with doors at 1:00 PM and the movie at 2:00 PM.
